content:
The LattePanda Mu Ultra is an x86 Compute Module powered by an Intel Core Ultra 5 226V or Ultra 7 256V Lunar Lake processor and equipped with 16GB of DDR5 memory. Offered in the same compact 69.6 × 60mm form factor as the earlier LattePanda Mu Alder Lake-N system-on-module (N100 or Core i3-N305), it delivers much higher performance, including up 115 TOPS of AI performance. Target applications include robotics, industrial automation, portable instruments, vision AI, and a range of Edge AI applications. LattePanda Mu Ultra Specifications: Lunar Lake SoC (one or the other) Intel Core Ultra 5 Processor 226V CPU – Octa-core processor up to 4.5 GHz GPU – 7x Xe-core Intel Arc 130V GPU up to 1.85 GHz AI – 40 TOPS Intel AI Boost; combined up to 97 TOPS Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor 256V CPU – Octa-core processor up to 4.8 GHz GPU – 8x Xe-core Intel Arc [...]
